appearance.densityDesc: Affects list row height and spacing

reading.bodyFontDesc: Hyperlegible is tuned for low-vision readability
reading.readingTimeDesc: Show estimated reading time in the article info bar
reading.transSwitchDesc: Show an Original / Bilingual / Translation switch above a translated article (always available from the toolbar's translate menu)
reading.defaultOpenModeDesc: How articles open by default — individual feeds can override this in Subscriptions

fonts.previewUi: Inbox · Settings · 收件箱 · 设置 · 0123
fonts.previewReader: A calm, local-first reading experience. The quick brown fox 数据与隐私。
fonts.libraryDesc: Download open-source fonts (OFL / Apache only). CJK fonts are large and take a while.
fonts.needName: Couldn't read the font name — enter it manually
fonts.addUrl: Add a custom font by URL
fonts.addUrlDesc: Paste a direct link to an open-source font file (e.g. a .woff2 / .ttf in a GitHub release).

subscriptions.opmlExported: OPML exported to the Downloads folder
subscriptions.rsshubInstanceDesc: Paste rsshub:// links to subscribe. Leave blank for the public rsshub.app, or point to your self-hosted instance.
subscriptions.dirDesc: The curated directory Discover uses; checked for updates every 24 hours.
subscriptions.dirUpToDate: Directory is already up to date
subscriptions.dirSourcePending: Not fetched yet — try Refresh now
subscriptions.dirSourceAddDesc: Direct JSON link to a self-hosted or community directory; entries merge with the official one, deduped by feedUrl.
subscriptions.feedUrlDesc: Repoint this feed if the site moved it — articles, folder and settings are kept.

filters.title: Filter rules
filters.intro: Rules run on every new article as it arrives — and, when you save, on matching articles you already have. Skip noisy keywords, or auto mark-read / star the things you care about.
filters.confirmSkipMessage: This discard rule matches {count} articles you already have. Saving will permanently delete them — this can't be undone. New articles will still be filtered going forward.

sync.syncHint: Syncing pulls subscriptions from your server and aligns read / starred state both ways. It also runs automatically each time feeds are refreshed.
sync.connectHint: Connect to a self-hosted FreshRSS or Miniflux server to sync subscriptions and reading state across devices.
sync.minifluxPassHint: Miniflux requires an application password — create one under Settings → API Keys in your Miniflux account.
sync.reasonOauth: Requires OAuth developer credentials, not yet supported
sync.reasonEntitlements: Requires native macOS entitlements, not yet supported
sync.syncDone: Sync complete · aligned the state of {count} articles

shortcuts.pageReader: Page down / up in the reader (with ⇧)
shortcuts.openOriginalClick: Open the original in the browser (keeps selection)

notifications.allowDesc: Show a system notification when new articles arrive after a refresh
notifications.badgeDesc: Show the unread article count on the Dock icon
notifications.soundDesc: Play the system sound when a notification appears

advanced.dedupDesc: When multiple feeds push the same link, keep only the first one fetched
advanced.retentionDesc: Read articles older than this are cleaned up automatically (starred and read-later excluded)
advanced.cleanupNowDesc: Run a one-time cleanup using the retention setting above
advanced.vacuumDesc: Reclaim disk space used by deleted articles (VACUUM)
advanced.cleanupForever: Currently set to keep forever, no cleanup performed
advanced.concurrencyDesc: How many feeds to refresh at the same time at most
advanced.resetSettingsDesc: Clear all preferences and configuration; feeds and articles are unaffected
advanced.resetConfirm: This will clear all app settings (including AI, sync, and network configuration). Feeds and articles are unaffected. Continue?
advanced.clearDataDesc: Delete all feeds and articles — cannot be undone
advanced.clearConfirm: This will permanently delete all feeds, folders, and articles, and cannot be undone. Exporting OPML first is recommended. Continue?
advanced.aiProviderDesc: The LLM provider powering summaries, Q&A, the digest, and AI translation
advanced.aiApiKeyDesc: The key is stored only in the local database and is never uploaded
advanced.aiModelDesc: Leave blank to use the provider's default model
advanced.aiBaseUrlDesc: API endpoint root. Leave blank for the provider's official endpoint, or point to any compatible provider (OpenRouter, Groq, DeepSeek, a local server)
advanced.translateEngineDesc: Default engine for translating articles. LLM uses the AI provider above; Google, DeepL and Bing are standalone services. You can switch it per article from the reader
advanced.translateLangDesc: Default language articles are translated into. Defaults to the interface language; switchable per article from the reader
advanced.translateAutoDesc: Automatically translate articles whose language differs from the translation language when you open them. Override per feed from the reader's translate menu

about.tagline: A fast, native RSS reader, keyboard-first.
about.creditsBuilt: Built natively with Wails, Go, and Vue.
about.creditsThanks: Thanks to everyone who maintains open standards — RSS keeps independent writing reachable.
about.copyDiag: Click to copy version + platform (paste into bug reports)

ai.tuningDesc: How the Q&A and digest gather context. Changes take effect on the next question — no restart needed.
ai.ragLimitDesc: How many relevant articles the Q&A retrieves for a question.
ai.recentLimitDesc: Articles used when a question has no keyword matches (e.g. “today's headlines”).
ai.digestLimitDesc: How many recent articles the digest briefing synthesizes.
ai.summaryCharsDesc: Characters of each article's summary fed to the assistant.
ai.historyTurnsDesc: How many earlier Q&A turns are kept as context for follow-ups.
ai.chipCapDesc: How many source articles show before the rest fold into “+N more”.
ai.providerListDesc: Add multiple providers and choose which one summaries, Q&A, digest, and translation use.
ai.providerNameDesc: A label for this provider (e.g. “Work OpenAI”, “Local llama”).
ai.apiTypeDesc: The request format used to call it — needn't match the vendor name. Pick Custom for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
ai.aiTestDesc: Send one minimal request to check the key, Base URL and model

error.networkCloudflare: {host} is gated by Cloudflare and refused this request — the origin is fine, but their bot check blocks Hive's HTTP client. Try opening the article in a browser or, if it's a feed source, switching to another instance.
error.networkForbidden: {host} refused this request (HTTP {status}). The site likely blocks RSS readers or requires a login.
error.networkNotFound: Couldn't find this content on {host} (HTTP {status}). The article or feed may have been removed.
error.networkRateLimit: {host} is rate-limiting Hive (HTTP 429). Wait a minute and try again.
error.networkServerError: {host} returned a server error (HTTP {status}). Try again later.
error.noAiKey: No AI API key set — add one in Settings → Advanced
error.aiTestEmpty: The provider returned no text — check the model and endpoint
error.aiTestTimeout: The provider did not answer within 20 seconds — check the Base URL and the network
error.tagNameExists: A tag with that name already exists
error.folderNameExists: A folder with that name already exists
error.emptyRuleQuery: Enter at least one keyword for the rule
error.noFeedFound: No feed found at that URL
error.responseTooLarge: The server's response was too large
error.alreadySubscribed: You are already subscribed to this feed
error.noArticleUrl: This article has no source URL
error.noArticleBody: This article has no text to summarize
error.noExtractableContent: Couldn’t extract readable content from that page
error.freshrssLoginFailed: Login failed — check the server URL, username and password
error.freshrssNoToken: Server did not return an auth token
error.freshrssNotConnected: Not connected to a sync server
error.youtubeChannelNotFound: Couldn't find a YouTube channel id on that page
error.newsletterMissingFields: Enter the IMAP host, username and password
error.newsletterPollTimeout: The IMAP server didn't respond in time — check the host, port and your network
error.noNotionToken: Add your Notion integration token in Settings → Integrations
error.noNotionPage: Set the target Notion page id in Settings → Integrations
error.noPocketConfig: Add your Pocket consumer key and access token in Settings → Integrations
error.noInstapaperConfig: Add your Instapaper username and password in Settings → Integrations
error.noKindleConfig: Configure your Kindle address and SMTP server in Settings → Integrations
error.directorySourceInvalid: Invalid directory URL — needs a direct http(s) JSON link
